title: Great transfer
text: Great taransfer. The driver was on time for our pickup from the cruise terminal. Highly recommend. Don’t hesitate o book this transfer.
author: Edward_G

title: Perfect Cruise Port Pick Up
text: Easy to book. Great communication with the company and the driver directly for pick up after our cruise. I booked 11:00 am (booked almost a year in advance with no idea what time we’d get off the ship) but when we were walking off the ship at 9:00 am and heading for baggage pick up, I told the driver we’d be ready sooner and he came early. Super easy meet up and great over all service!
author: LoriRae_A

title: Excellent Service
text: Driver arrived ahead of our scheduled pick up time from the cruise port which was perfect because I had booked it two hours later, not knowing when we would get off. He was very communicative with me and was waiting just outside with our name, therefore easy to locate.
author: LoriRae_A

title: Driver was there when...
text: Driver was there when promised.  He was very professional and efficient.  Knew exactly where he was going.  Would highly recommend using this service.
author: Beverly_S
